verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lē·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: FALOU mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־ כָּל־ עֲדַ֧ת בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֥ אֲלֵהֶ֖ם קְדֹשִׁ֣ים תִּהְי֑וּ כִּ֣י קָד֔וֹשׁ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem qə·ḏō·šîm tih·yū kî qā·ḏō·wōš ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: Speak to the whole congregation . . . of Israel and tell them Be holy because I the LORD your God am holy
verses.literalPt: Fala a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Santos sereis, porque eu, o SENHOR vosso Deus, sou santo.

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ אִמּ֤וֹ וְאָבִיו֙ תִּירָ֔אוּ וְאֶת־ שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖י תִּשְׁמֹ֑רוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš ’im·mōw wə·’ā·ḇîw tî·rā·’ū wə·’eṯ- šab·bə·ṯō·ṯay tiš·mō·rū ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: Each of you must respect his mother and father and you must keep My Sabbaths I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Cada um temerá a sua mãe e a seu pai, e guardará os meus sábados. Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּפְנוּ֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אֱלִילִ֔ים וֵֽאלֹהֵי֙ מַסֵּכָ֔ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ לָכֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tip̄·nū ’el- hā·’ĕ·lî·lîm wê·lō·hê mas·sê·ḵāh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū lā·ḵem ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: Do not turn to idols or make for yourselves molten . . . gods I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Não vos virareis para os ídolos nem vos fareis deuses de fundição. Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

verses.original: וְכִ֧י תִזְבְּח֛וּ זֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַיהוָ֑ה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֖ם תִּזְבָּחֻֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî ṯiz·bə·ḥū ze·ḇaḥ šə·lā·mîm Yah·weh lir·ṣō·nə·ḵem tiz·bā·ḥu·hū
verses.literal: When you sacrifice a peace offering to the LORD you shall offer it for your acceptance
verses.literalPt: E, quando oferecerdes sacrifício pacífico ao SENHOR, da vossa própria vontade o oferecereis.

verses.original: בְּי֧וֹם זִבְחֲכֶ֛ם יֵאָכֵ֖ל וּמִֽמָּחֳרָ֑ת וְהַנּוֹתָר֙ עַד־ י֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י בָּאֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yō·wm ziḇ·ḥă·ḵem yê·’ā·ḵêl ū·mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ wə·han·nō·w·ṯār ‘aḏ- yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî bā·’êš yiś·śā·rêp̄
verses.literal: It shall be eaten on the day you sacrifice it or on the next day but what remains . . . on the third day must be burned up . . .
verses.literalPt: No dia em que o sacrificardes, e no dia seguinte, se comerá; mas o que sobejar ao terceiro dia, será queimado com fogo.

verses.original: וְאִ֛ם הֵאָכֹ֥ל יֵאָכֵ֖ל בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י פִּגּ֥וּל ה֖וּא לֹ֥א יֵרָצֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im hê·’ā·ḵōl yê·’ā·ḵêl bay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî pig·gūl hū lō yê·rā·ṣeh
verses.literal: If any of it is eaten . . . on the third day it is tainted and will not be accepted
verses.literalPt: E se alguma coisa dele for comida ao terceiro dia, coisa abominável é; não será aceita.

verses.original: וְאֹֽכְלָיו֙ עֲוֺנ֣וֹ יִשָּׂ֔א כִּֽי־ אֶת־ קֹ֥דֶשׁ יְהוָ֖ה חִלֵּ֑ל וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ō·ḵə·lāw ‘ă·wō·nōw yiś·śā kî- ’eṯ- qō·ḏeš Yah·weh ḥil·lêl wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh han·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w mê·‘am·me·hā
verses.literal: Whoever eats it will bear his iniquity for he has profaned what is holy to the LORD That person must be cut off from his people
verses.literalPt: E qualquer que o comer levará a sua iniqüidade, porquanto profanou a santidade do SENHOR; por isso tal alma será extirpada do seu povo.

verses.original: וּֽבְקֻצְרְכֶם֙ אֶת־ קְצִ֣יר אַרְצְכֶ֔ם לֹ֧א תְכַלֶּ֛ה פְּאַ֥ת שָׂדְךָ֖ לִקְצֹ֑ר וְלֶ֥קֶט קְצִֽירְךָ֖ לֹ֥א תְלַקֵּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·quṣ·rə·ḵem ’eṯ- qə·ṣîr ’ar·ṣə·ḵem lō ṯə·ḵal·leh pə·’aṯ śā·ḏə·ḵā liq·ṣōr wə·le·qeṭ qə·ṣî·rə·ḵā lō ṯə·laq·qêṭ
verses.literal: When you reap the harvest of your land you are not to reap to the very edges of your field . . . or gather the gleanings of your harvest . . .
verses.literalPt: Quando também fizerdes a colheita da vossa terra, o canto do teu campo não segarás totalmente, nem as espigas caídas colherás da tua sega.

verses.original: וְכַרְמְךָ֙ לֹ֣א תְעוֹלֵ֔ל וּפֶ֥רֶט כַּרְמְךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְלַקֵּ֑ט לֶֽעָנִ֤י וְלַגֵּר֙ תַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֹתָ֔ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵar·mə·ḵā lō ṯə·‘ō·w·lêl ū·p̄e·reṭ kar·mə·ḵā lō ṯə·laq·qêṭ le·‘ā·nî wə·lag·gêr ta·‘ă·zōḇ ’ō·ṯām ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: You must not strip your vineyard bare or gather its . . . fallen grapes Leave them for the poor and the foreigner I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Semelhantemente não rabiscarás a tua vinha, nem colherás os bagos caídos da tua vinha; deixá-los-ás ao pobre e ao estrangeiro. Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

verses.original: לֹ֖א תִּגְנֹ֑בוּ וְלֹא־ תְכַחֲשׁ֥וּ וְלֹֽא־ תְשַׁקְּר֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ בַּעֲמִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lō tiḡ·nō·ḇū wə·lō- ṯə·ḵa·ḥă·šū wə·lō- ṯə·šaq·qə·rū ’îš ba·‘ă·mî·ṯōw
verses.literal: You must not steal You must not lie . . . or deceive one another
verses.literalPt: Não furtareis, nem mentireis, nem usareis de falsidade cada um com o seu próximo;

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ תִשָּׁבְע֥וּ בִשְׁמִ֖י לַשָּׁ֑קֶר וְחִלַּלְתָּ֛ אֶת־ שֵׁ֥ם אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ṯiš·šā·ḇə·‘ū ḇiš·mî laš·šā·qer wə·ḥil·lal·tā ’eṯ- šêm ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: You must not swear falsely by My name and so profane the name of your God I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Nem jurareis falso pelo meu nome, pois profanarás o nome do teu Deus. Eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תַעֲשֹׁ֥ק אֶת־ רֵֽעֲךָ֖ וְלֹ֣א תִגְזֹ֑ל לֹֽא־ תָלִ֞ין פְּעֻלַּ֥ת שָׂכִ֛יר אִתְּךָ֖ עַד־ בֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯa·‘ă·šōq ’eṯ- rê·‘ă·ḵā wə·lō ṯiḡ·zōl lō- ṯā·lîn pə·‘ul·laṯ śā·ḵîr ’it·tə·ḵā ‘aḏ- bō·qer
verses.literal: You must not defraud your neighbor or rob him You must not withhold until morning the wages due a hired hand
verses.literalPt: Não oprimirás o teu próximo, nem o roubarás; a paga do diarista não ficará contigo até pela manhã.

verses.original: לֹא־ תְקַלֵּ֣ל חֵרֵ֔שׁ וְלִפְנֵ֣י עִוֵּ֔ר לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן מִכְשֹׁ֑ל וְיָרֵ֥אתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯə·qal·lêl ḥê·rêš wə·lip̄·nê ‘iw·wêr lō ṯit·tên miḵ·šōl wə·yā·rê·ṯā mê·’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: You must not curse the deaf or place a stumbling block before the blind . . . but you shall fear your God I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Não amaldiçoarás ao surdo, nem porás tropeço diante do cego; mas temerás o teu Deus. Eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: לֹא־ תַעֲשׂ֥וּ עָ֙וֶל֙ בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֔ט לֹא־ תִשָּׂ֣א פְנֵי־ דָ֔ל וְלֹ֥א תֶהְדַּ֖ר פְּנֵ֣י גָד֑וֹל בְּצֶ֖דֶק תִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט עֲמִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯa·‘ă·śū ‘ā·wel bam·miš·pāṭ lō- ṯiś·śā p̄ə·nê- ḏāl wə·lō ṯeh·dar pə·nê ḡā·ḏō·wl bə·ṣe·ḏeq tiš·pōṭ ‘ă·mî·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: You must not pervert . . . justice you must not show partiality . . . to the poor or favoritism . . . to the rich you are to judge your neighbor fairly
verses.literalPt: Não farás injustiça no juízo; não respeitarás o pobre, nem honrarás o poderoso; com justiça julgarás o teu próximo.

verses.original: לֹא־ תֵלֵ֤ךְ רָכִיל֙ בְּעַמֶּ֔יךָ לֹ֥א תַעֲמֹ֖ד עַל־ דַּ֣ם רֵעֶ֑ךָ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯê·lêḵ rā·ḵîl bə·‘am·me·ḵā lō ṯa·‘ă·mōḏ ‘al- dam rê·‘e·ḵā ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: You must not go about spreading slander among your people You must not endanger . . . the life of your neighbor I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Não andarás como mexeriqueiro entre o teu povo; não te porás contra o sangue do teu próximo. Eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תִשְׂנָ֥א אֶת־ אָחִ֖יךָ בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ הוֹכֵ֤חַ תּוֹכִ֙יחַ֙ אֶת־ עֲמִיתֶ֔ךָ וְלֹא־ תִשָּׂ֥א עָלָ֖יו חֵֽטְא׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯiś·nā ’eṯ- ’ā·ḥî·ḵā bil·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā hō·w·ḵê·aḥ tō·w·ḵî·aḥ ’eṯ- ‘ă·mî·ṯe·ḵā wə·lō- ṯiś·śā ‘ā·lāw ḥêṭ
verses.literal: You must not harbor hatred against your brother in your heart Directly rebuke . . . your neighbor so that you will not incur guilt on account of him
verses.literalPt: Não odiarás a teu irmão no teu coração; não deixarás de repreender o teu próximo, e por causa dele não sofrerás pecado.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תִקֹּ֤ם וְלֹֽא־ תִטֹּר֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֔ךָ וְאָֽהַבְתָּ֥ לְרֵעֲךָ֖ כָּמ֑וֹךָ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯiq·qōm wə·lō- ṯiṭ·ṭōr ’eṯ- bə·nê ‘am·me·ḵā wə·’ā·haḇ·tā lə·rê·‘ă·ḵā kā·mō·w·ḵā ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: Do not seek revenge . . . or bear a grudge against any of your people but love your neighbor as yourself I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Não te vingarás nem guardarás ira contra os filhos do teu povo; mas amarás o teu próximo como a ti mesmo. Eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: אֶֽת־ חֻקֹּתַי֮ תִּשְׁמֹרוּ֒ בְּהֶמְתְּךָ֙ לֹא־ תַרְבִּ֣יעַ כִּלְאַ֔יִם שָׂדְךָ֖ לֹא־ תִזְרַ֣ע כִּלְאָ֑יִם וּבֶ֤גֶד כִּלְאַ֙יִם֙ שַֽׁעַטְנֵ֔ז לֹ֥א יַעֲלֶ֖ה עָלֶֽיךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- ḥuq·qō·ṯay tiš·mō·rū bə·hem·tə·ḵā lō- ṯar·bî·a‘ kil·’a·yim śā·ḏə·ḵā lō- ṯiz·ra‘ kil·’ā·yim ū·ḇe·ḡeḏ kil·’a·yim ša·‘aṭ·nêz lō ya·‘ă·leh ‘ā·le·ḵā
verses.literal: You are to keep My statutes You shall not crossbreed two different kinds of livestock you shall not sow your fields . . . with two kinds of seed and you shall not wear . . . clothing made of two kinds of material
verses.literalPt: Guardarás os meus estatutos; não permitirás que se ajuntem misturadamente os teus animais de diferentes espécies; no teu campo não semearás sementes diversas, e não vestirás roupa de diversos estofos misturados.

verses.original: וְ֠אִישׁ כִּֽי־ יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אֶת־ אִשָּׁ֜ה שִׁכְבַת־ זֶ֗רַע וְהִ֤וא שִׁפְחָה֙ נֶחֱרֶ֣פֶת לְאִ֔ישׁ וְהָפְדֵּה֙ לֹ֣א נִפְדָּ֔תָה א֥וֹ חֻפְשָׁ֖ה לֹ֣א נִתַּן־ לָ֑הּ בִּקֹּ֧רֶת תִּהְיֶ֛ה לֹ֥א יוּמְת֖וּ כִּי־ לֹ֥א חֻפָּֽשָׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš kî- yiš·kaḇ ’eṯ- ’iš·šāh šiḵ·ḇaṯ- ze·ra‘ wə·hi·w šip̄·ḥāh ne·ḥĕ·re·p̄eṯ lə·’îš wə·hā·p̄ə·dêh lō nip̄·dā·ṯāh ’ōw ḥup̄·šāh lō nit·tan- lāh biq·qō·reṯ tih·yeh lō yū·mə·ṯū kî- lō ḥup·pā·šāh
verses.literal: If a man lies - carnally with a slave girl promised to another man but who has not . . . been redeemed or given her freedom there must be due punishment But they are not to be put to death because . . . she had not been freed
verses.literalPt: E, quando um homem se deitar com uma mulher que for serva desposada com outro homem, e não for resgatada nem se lhe houver dado liberdade, então serão açoitados; não morrerão, pois ela não foi libertada.

verses.original: וְהֵבִ֤יא אֶת־ אֲשָׁמוֹ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה אֶל־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד אֵ֖יל אָשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·ḇî ’eṯ- ’ă·šā·mōw Yah·weh ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ ’êl ’ā·šām
verses.literal: The man, however, must bring a ram to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting as his guilt offering . . . to the LORD
verses.literalPt: E, por expiação da sua culpa, trará ao SENHOR, à porta da tenda da congregação, um carneiro da expiação,

verses.original: וְכִפֶּר֩ עָלָ֨יו הַכֹּהֵ֜ן בְּאֵ֤יל הָֽאָשָׁם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ חַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֑א וְנִסְלַ֣ח ל֔וֹ מֵחַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽא׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·lāw hak·kō·hên bə·’êl hā·’ā·šām lip̄·nê Yah·weh ‘al- ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā wə·nis·laḥ lōw mê·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā
verses.literal: The priest shall make atonement on his behalf before the LORD with the ram of the guilt offering for the sin he has committed and he will be forgiven the sin he has committed
verses.literalPt: E, com o carneiro da expiação da culpa, o sacerdote fará propiciação por ele perante o SENHOR, pelo pecado que cometeu; e este lhe será perdoado.

verses.original: וְכִי־ תָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ וּנְטַעְתֶּם֙ כָּל־ עֵ֣ץ מַאֲכָ֔ל וַעֲרַלְתֶּ֥ם עָרְלָת֖וֹ אֶת־ פִּרְי֑וֹ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֗ים יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם עֲרֵלִ֖ים לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- ṯā·ḇō·’ū ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ū·nə·ṭa‘·tem kāl- ‘êṣ ma·’ă·ḵāl wa·‘ă·ral·tem ‘ā·rə·lā·ṯōw ’eṯ- pir·yōw šā·lōš šā·nîm yih·yeh lā·ḵem ‘ă·rê·lîm lō yê·’ā·ḵêl
verses.literal: When you enter . . . the land and plant any kind of tree for food you shall regard the fruit as forbidden For three years it will be forbidden to you and must not be eaten
verses.literalPt: E, quando tiverdes entrado na terra, e plantardes toda a árvore de comer, ser-vos-á incircunciso o seu fruto; três anos vos será incircunciso; dele não se comerá.

verses.original: וּבַשָּׁנָה֙ הָרְבִיעִ֔ת יִהְיֶ֖ה כָּל־ פִּרְי֑וֹ קֹ֥דֶשׁ הִלּוּלִ֖ים לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇaš·šā·nāh hā·rə·ḇî·‘iṯ yih·yeh kāl- pir·yōw qō·ḏeš hil·lū·lîm Yah·weh
verses.literal: In the fourth year all its fruit must be consecrated as a praise offering to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Porém no quarto ano todo o seu fruto será santo para dar louvores ao SENHOR.

verses.original: וּבַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַחֲמִישִׁ֗ת תֹּֽאכְלוּ֙ אֶת־ פִּרְי֔וֹ לְהוֹסִ֥יף לָכֶ֖ם תְּבוּאָת֑וֹ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇaš·šā·nāh ha·ḥă·mî·šiṯ tō·ḵə·lū ’eṯ- pir·yōw lə·hō·w·sîp̄ lā·ḵem tə·ḇū·’ā·ṯōw ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: But in the fifth year you may eat its fruit thus your harvest will be increased I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: E no quinto ano comereis o seu fruto, para que vos faça aumentar a sua produção. Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

verses.original: לֹ֥א תֹאכְל֖וּ עַל־ הַדָּ֑ם לֹ֥א תְנַחֲשׁ֖וּ וְלֹ֥א תְעוֹנֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯō·ḵə·lū ‘al- had·dām lō ṯə·na·ḥă·šū wə·lō ṯə·‘ō·w·nê·nū
verses.literal: You must not eat anything with blood still in it You must not practice divination or sorcery
verses.literalPt: Não comereis coisa alguma com o sangue; não agourareis nem adivinhareis.

verses.original: לֹ֣א תַקִּ֔פוּ פְּאַ֖ת רֹאשְׁכֶ֑ם וְלֹ֣א תַשְׁחִ֔ית אֵ֖ת פְּאַ֥ת זְקָנֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯaq·qi·p̄ū pə·’aṯ rō·šə·ḵem wə·lō ṯaš·ḥîṯ ’êṯ pə·’aṯ zə·qā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: You must not cut off the hair at the sides of your head . . . or clip off the edges of your beard
verses.literalPt: Não cortareis o cabelo, arredondando os cantos da vossa cabeça, nem danificareis as extremidades da tua barba.

verses.original: וְשֶׂ֣רֶט לָנֶ֗פֶשׁ לֹ֤א תִתְּנוּ֙ בִּבְשַׂרְכֶ֔ם וּכְתֹ֣בֶת קַֽעֲקַ֔ע לֹ֥א תִתְּנ֖וּ בָּכֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śe·reṭ lā·ne·p̄eš lō ṯit·tə·nū biḇ·śar·ḵem ū·ḵə·ṯō·ḇeṯ qa·‘ă·qa‘ lō ṯit·tə·nū bā·ḵem ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: You must not make any cuts . . . in your bodies for the dead or put tattoo . . . marks on yourselves I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Pelos mortos não dareis golpes na vossa carne; nem fareis marca alguma sobre vós. Eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: אַל־ תְּחַלֵּ֥ל אֶֽת־ בִּתְּךָ֖ לְהַזְנוֹתָ֑הּ וְלֹא־ תִזְנֶ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ וּמָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ זִמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tə·ḥal·lêl ’eṯ- bit·tə·ḵā lə·haz·nō·w·ṯāh wə·lō- ṯiz·neh hā·’ā·reṣ ū·mā·lə·’āh hā·’ā·reṣ zim·māh
verses.literal: You must not defile your daughter by making her a prostitute or the land will be prostituted and filled . . . with depravity
verses.literalPt: Não contaminarás a tua filha, fazendo-a prostituir-se; para que a terra não se prostitua, nem se encha de maldade.

verses.original: אֶת־ שַׁבְּתֹתַ֣י תִּשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י תִּירָ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- šab·bə·ṯō·ṯay tiš·mō·rū ū·miq·dā·šî tî·rā·’ū ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Guardareis os meus sábados, e o meu santuário reverenciareis. Eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּפְנ֤וּ אֶל־ הָאֹבֹת֙ וְאֶל־ הַיִּדְּעֹנִ֔ים אַל־ תְּבַקְשׁ֖וּ לְטָמְאָ֣ה בָהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tip̄·nū ’el- hā·’ō·ḇōṯ wə·’el- hay·yid·də·‘ō·nîm ’al- tə·ḇaq·šū lə·ṭā·mə·’āh ḇā·hem ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: You must not turn to mediums or spiritists do not seek them out . . . or you will be defiled by them I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Não vos virareis para os adivinhadores e encantadores; não os busqueis, contaminando-vos com eles. Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

verses.original: מִפְּנֵ֤י שֵׂיבָה֙ תָּק֔וּם וְהָדַרְתָּ֖ פְּנֵ֣י זָקֵ֑ן וְיָרֵ֥אתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: mip·pə·nê śê·ḇāh tā·qūm wə·hā·ḏar·tā pə·nê zā·qên wə·yā·rê·ṯā mê·’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: You are to rise in the presence of the elderly honor . . . the aged and fear your God I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Diante das cãs te levantarás, e honrarás a face do ancião; e temerás o teu Deus. Eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יָג֧וּר אִתְּךָ֛ גֵּ֖ר בְּאַרְצְכֶ֑ם לֹ֥א תוֹנ֖וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yā·ḡūr ’it·tə·ḵā gêr bə·’ar·ṣə·ḵem lō ṯō·w·nū ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: When a foreigner resides with you in your land you must not oppress him
verses.literalPt: E quando o estrangeiro peregrinar convosco na vossa terra, não o oprimireis.

verses.original: כְּאֶזְרָ֣ח מִכֶּם֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם הַגֵּ֣ר׀ הַגָּ֣ר אִתְּכֶ֗ם וְאָהַבְתָּ֥ לוֹ֙ כָּמ֔וֹךָ כִּֽי־ גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kə·’ez·rāḥ mik·kem yih·yeh lā·ḵem hag·gêr hag·gār ’it·tə·ḵem wə·’ā·haḇ·tā lōw kā·mō·w·ḵā kî- ḡê·rîm hĕ·yî·ṯem bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: You must treat the foreigner living among you as native-born . . . and love him as yourself for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt I am the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Como um natural entre vós será o estrangeiro que peregrina convosco; amá-lo-ás como a ti mesmo, pois estrangeiros fostes na terra do Egito. Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

verses.original: לֹא־ תַעֲשׂ֥וּ עָ֖וֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט בַּמִּדָּ֕ה בַּמִּשְׁקָ֖ל וּבַמְּשׂוּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯa·‘ă·śū ‘ā·wel bam·miš·pāṭ bam·mid·dāh bam·miš·qāl ū·ḇam·mə·śū·rāh
verses.literal: You must not use dishonest measures of length weight or volume
verses.literalPt: Não cometereis injustiça no juízo, nem na vara, nem no peso, nem na medida.

verses.original: מֹ֧אזְנֵי צֶ֣דֶק אַבְנֵי־ צֶ֗דֶק אֵ֥יפַת צֶ֛דֶק וְהִ֥ין צֶ֖דֶק יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם אֲנִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: mō·zə·nê ṣe·ḏeq ’aḇ·nê- ṣe·ḏeq ’ê·p̄aṯ ṣe·ḏeq wə·hîn ṣe·ḏeq yih·yeh lā·ḵem ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ’ă·šer- hō·w·ṣê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: You shall maintain honest scales and weights an honest ephah and an honest hin I am the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Balanças justas, pesos justos, efa justo, e justo him tereis. Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, que vos tirei da terra do Egito.

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֶת־ כָּל־ חֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mar·tem ’eṯ- kāl- ḥuq·qō·ṯay wə·’eṯ- kāl- miš·pā·ṭay wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem ’ō·ṯām ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: You must keep all My statutes and all My ordinances and follow them I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Por isso guardareis todos os meus estatutos, e todos os meus juízos, e os cumprireis. Eu sou o SENHOR.
